name: Pasta
message: 「Damn it, nya... You're pretty persistent, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, I can fight now, so move! Hey, move! I can fight alongside you!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine. I can keep fighting for another hour or two.」
I can manage if I just focus on defending.

name: Pasta
message: 「That's enough of your tough act, nya!」
We're surrounded! Is this the end?

name: Paqy
message: 「You, the first two, and the three reinforcements--one plus two plus three equals six.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Uhh... so it goes like nya-this... and like this... nya-nya...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll take the front! So rest up, Synn.」
One of the low-ranking demons took a direct hit from a beam of light that flew in from out of nowhere and burst into flames.

name: Pasta
message: 「Reinforcements, nya?! Still, if it's just one person--」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you think you're doing, Sakura-kun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The hero arrives at the very end」

name: Pasta
message: 「I was just one step away, nya! But I'll retreat for now, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Remember this, nya! Besides, you guys are already too late anyway, nya!」
The presence of magic fades away.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Villains are required to say lines like that when they run away」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, leaving me behind like that while you're with everyone……」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka! How are you feeling? Can you move?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What are you talking about, Synn, don't treat me like an invalid!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's fine. I put everything into defending, so I managed to hold out.」

name: Misa
message: 「How pathetic. The best defense is a good offense.」

name: Misa
message: 「You took advantage of the dark and did something horrible to Nanaka-san, didn't you!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I hit the nail on the head, didn't I! Even for you, Sakura-kun, I didn't think you'd stoop that low!」
A thick, viscous presence, like boiled-down pitch darkness, came drifting toward us.
Nanaka was trembling even more violently than before.
I stepped forward as if to shield Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, I'm fine! I'm okay! I'll be okay this time!」
The grove harboring that dense presence stood dead silent, without even a single rustle.
Yet, we could neither approach it nor move away to escape.
As if by magic, an immense presence overflowed.
A malevolence so overwhelming it made that pasta from earlier look like a mere toy.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shouldn't we run!? After all, they say running away is the best of the thirty-six stratagems, lest you chase two hares and catch neither.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think it's going to let us get away.」

name: Misa
message: 「If running won't do any good, we have no choice but to fight!」
Misa's voice trembled as she said it.
Across the path from where the sinister presence lurked, a massive presence appeared in the grove of trees.
There had been no warning at all.
It held no malice--just a quiet presence.
Yet it was vivid enough to freeze the stillness of the night in an instant.
A few moments later, as if having seen it off, the second presence disappeared as well.
My hands, which had been gripping my weapon tightly, were clammy with sweat.
Nanaka was hugging herself tightly, as if trying to keep warm.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I want to take a hot bath right now... and go to sleep」
That was the incident that occurred on the first day of December.
I had no idea what had frightened Nanaka so badly.
